roadmap.title: Story campaign and present day
roadmap.description: Play Sequences 1 through 6, the present-day sequences, and the glitched memory finale while completing every main-mission optional objective for full synchronization. Pick up the story-adjacent unlocks as they appear: clear Anticosti before leaving it (Owned), counter smoke bombs with the gas mask once it arrives in Sequence 3, survive an early reverse boarding, and use the grenade launcher's sleep and berserk grenades on a five-enemy group.

roadmap.title: World, collectibles and naval completion
roadmap.description: Free-roam cleanup: capture every fort, Gang HQ and settlement, finish renovations and outposts, farm the stalker counters before the Gang HQs thin them out, and clear the collectibles (Animus Fragments, Native Pillars, Templar Maps, computers), including the Native hills and ice caves and their armor rewards. Finish the remaining activities: supply camps, ship convoys, prisoner ships, the narwhal hunt, assassin interceptions, icebergs and ice sheets, the four legendary battles after fully upgrading the Morrigan, and 17 Naval Campaign missions from the captain's cabin.

roadmap.title: Abstergo challenges and cheat achievements
roadmap.description: Finish the Abstergo challenge list to 65 of 70 so the HUNTED, ENDURANCE and VETERANS cheats are unlocked (Dedicated Employee needs only 35), then play each cheat achievement with that cheat as the only active one: sink 10 ships in the North Atlantic without dying for HUNTED and ENDURANCE, take 10 large supply camps for VETERANS, and kill 30 guards without dying for ENDURANCE. Turn every cheat back off afterwards so normal achievements are not disabled.

steps.text: Play the Sequence 1 memories through to the end of the sequence.
Play the Sequence 2 memories through to the end of the sequence.
Play the Sequence 3 memories through to the end of the sequence.
Play the Sequence 4 memories through to the end of the sequence.

achievements.displayName: One legend dies, and one is born

steps.text: Play the Sequence 5 memories through to the end of the sequence.
Play the Sequence 6 memories through to the end of the sequence.
Finish the last memory in the glitched @mechanic{Incomplete Memories} sequence.
Play the story through all six sequences and the present-day sequences to the ending.
Play the first present-day sequence to its conclusion.
Play the second present-day sequence to its conclusion.
Play the third present-day sequence to its conclusion.
Play the fourth present-day sequence to its conclusion.

achievements.description: Achieve 100% synchronization in all main missions
achievements.summary: Complete every optional objective in all main missions for 100% synchronization.

guide.context: Optional objectives can be completed on separate replays of the same memory, so nothing is lost by missing one on the first pass.

steps.text: During the story, finish every optional objective listed for each main mission in Sequences 1-6 and the glitched Incomplete Memories.
Replay any memory with an unfinished objective from the @mechanic{Progress Tracker} and complete what is missing.
steps.note: Progress carries across replays, and darts and grenades make the optional objectives easier on a second attempt.

achievements.summary: Capture every Gang HQ in @loc{New York}.

steps.text: Clear each Gang HQ in @loc{New York}; a takeover usually needs the leader killed, the flag cut down, and one more objective.
steps.note: Finish the stalker counters first, because each captured HQ thins out the stalkers left in the city.

guide.context: Only counter-attacks that play the kill animation count; a stab-style takedown does not. The stalker counter is in the statistics menu.

steps.text: As a stalker attacks, press the counter button (E on PC), then press attack (left mouse button) to finish the kill animation.
Farm the spawn near the @loc{Stuyvesant's Farm} viewpoint (582, -421) in @loc{New York}, where one stalker waits in a hay cart and two more sit on the roof.
steps.note: Fast travel away and back to reset the spawn, then repeat until 30 counter-kills register.

achievements.summary: Complete every renovation in the game.

guide.context: Renovations only become available in a quadrant after you capture the fort or Gang HQ that controls it.

steps.text: Complete every renovation across @loc{New York}, @loc{River Valley}, and the @loc{North Atlantic}.
steps.note: Renovations need metal, wood, stone, and cloth, and each one raises the income paid into your bank.

steps.text: Clear challenges under Settings > @mechanic{Abstergo Challenges} until 35 are complete; the 70 challenges fill up naturally while you finish the story and world content.

guide.context: @enemy{Men-O'-War} in the northeastern @loc{North Atlantic} and looted convoys are the best metal sources, and metal is the resource needed most.

steps.text: Gather resources from supply camps, outposts, settlements, and looted ships, and earn money from missions and renovations.
Buy every @item{Morrigan} upgrade until no slots remain.

guide.context: A supply camp's chest sits in a restricted zone and can only be opened while @mechanic{anonymous}.

steps.text: Open the supply chest at a camp; camps spawn across @loc{River Valley} as white cart icons, so fast travel between locations to find more.
Repeat until the supply camps counter in the statistics menu reaches 20.

guide.context: Both @item{Royal Navy} convoys (a black box marks their sails) and @item{French} convoys (marked with a black fleur-de-lis) count. Each convoy is a three-ship group, and sinking the ships and collecting the floating cargo counts without boarding.

steps.text: Sail the @loc{North Atlantic} and watch for convoys; paying a bartender in one of its taverns forces a convoy to spawn.
Run the farm loop: fast travel to @loc{Anticosti} and look south and northwest of it, then to @loc{Fort Louis} and check south of it, then back to @loc{New York} and repeat.
steps.note: A convoy is led by a frigate, and a prompt appears within about 300 m.

steps.text: Sink the convoy ships and collect the cargo; sinking the lead ship alone counts. Track the tally in the statistics menu.

achievements.description: Counter [20] smoke bombs successfully using a gas mask
achievements.summary: Counter 20 smoke bombs with a gas mask.

guide.context: Only agile assassins in orange throw smoke bombs, and the mask prompt appears once you have the gas mask. The mask becomes available in Sequence 3.

steps.text: Fight an agile @enemy{assassin}, wait for the smoke bomb, press the mask prompt, and stay in place until the bomb detonates.
Repeat until 20 counters register; the @item{Assassin Killer} outfit keeps a mask on automatically and counters without the prompt.

achievements.description: Repair all computers in Abstergo Entertainment

guide.context: Level 3 security clearance, granted near the end of the story, is needed to reach all 20 computers.

steps.text: Repair each computer by rotating the light rings around its core; solve the special refractive or reflective rings first.
Check the tablet map to find computers you have not repaired yet.

achievements.description: Visit every location in the game
achievements.summary: Visit every location in the game.

guide.context: A location stays a white ? in a black square until its quadrant's fort or Gang HQ is captured, and it turns white once you have visited it.

steps.text: Capture every fort and Gang HQ to reveal all locations in grey.
Travel to each revealed location until its map icon turns white.

achievements.summary: Collect the Native Armor after solving every Native Pillar.

steps.text: Solve the Native Pillar at each location; pillars are listed as mission items and each has a short puzzle.
Open the armor door at @loc{Orenda} in @loc{River Valley} to collect the @item{Native Armor}.

achievements.estTime: all Templar Maps and dig sites
achievements.summary: Collect the Templar Armor after finding every Templar Map and digging up its treasure.

guide.context: A Templar Map and its dig site must be on the same world map: @loc{New York}, @loc{River Valley}, or the @loc{North Atlantic}.

steps.text: Collect every @item{Templar Map}; they are mission items that show as small maps on the world map.
Dig at the coordinates printed in the corner of each map.
Collect the @item{Templar Armor} at @loc{The Sapphire} in the northeastern @loc{North Atlantic}.

achievements.description: Complete 17 story missions in the Naval Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete 17 of the 33 Naval Campaign missions.

guide.context: The Naval Campaign opens from the captain's cabin, and its seven mission sections unlock with story progress; repeating a mission does not add to the count.

steps.text: Check the captain's cabin regularly and send a ship on each new mission available; the missions run in real time.
Keep at least one @item{Man-O'-War} in the fleet for the extra storage that later missions need.
Finish new missions until 17 are complete; completing all 33 also awards @item{Altaïr's sword}.

guide.context: Viewpoint syncs reveal most fragments, while a few stay hidden until the fort watching over their area is captured.

steps.text: Sync every viewpoint and capture the forts to mark the fragments on the map.
Collect each fragment; fragments floating in open water are inside icebergs, so break the ice and swim through the fragment.

achievements.description: Complete every activity in a single location.
achievements.summary: Finish every activity in one location.

steps.text: During Sequence 1, clear everything on @loc{Anticosti} - chests, collectibles, and activities - before leaving the island.

guide.context: Capturing a fort reveals every location and uncharted collectible in its quadrant.

steps.text: Weaken a fort with the @item{Morrigan}'s cannons until its defenses are down.
Disembark and finish the fort's objectives on foot, usually killing the captain and one or two more targets.

guide.context: Settlements are one-time captures that turn friendly and pay out resources.

steps.text: Clear each settlement's objective list, such as killing the captain and the snipers, until every round-roofed settlement icon is captured.

guide.context: Fully upgrade the @item{Morrigan} before the final battle; the last fight is much harder than the other three.

steps.text: Beat the three legendary battles that appear near the corners of the @loc{North Atlantic} map as you capture each quadrant's fort.
Take the epic legendary battle that appears in the southwestern corner once the first three are done.
In the final fight, destroy the @enemy{Storm Fortress} first and use mortars on the two @enemy{Men-O'-War} that join below a quarter health.
Break icebergs with cannon fire while sailing the @loc{North Atlantic}; one hit shatters each, and some hide resources or Animus Fragments. The counter is in the statistics menu.

achievements.description: Break through 500 meters of Ice Sheets
achievements.summary: Smash through 500 meters of ice sheets.

guide.context: The @item{Morrigan}'s ram must be upgraded at least once before ice sheets can be broken.

steps.text: Drive the Morrigan through a floating ice sheet in the @loc{North Atlantic} and repeat the crossing two or three times to reach 500 meters.

achievements.summary: Free 300 British prisoners of war by boarding prisoner ships.

guide.context: Prisoner ships carry about 100 prisoners each, and damage to the ship kills prisoners, so expect four or five ships unless the prisoner frigate is left untouched.

steps.text: Find a prisoner convoy by waiting at @loc{Gros Morne} (483, -305) without moving or opening the map for 10-20 minutes, or by sailing laps of the @loc{North Atlantic}.
Destroy the convoy's escort ships only, then board the prisoner ship without firing on it to free the full 100.
Repeat until 300 prisoners are freed; the counter is in the statistics menu.

guide.context: The narwhal only appears on the map after @loc{Fort Baie Rouge} is captured.

steps.text: Capture @loc{Fort Baie Rouge} in the northeastern @loc{North Atlantic}, then sail to the narwhal icon (a swordfish-like marker with a horn) and harpoon it.
steps.note: Upgraded harpoon damage makes the hunt easier.

guide.context: A reverse boarding starts when an enemy ship rams the @item{Morrigan} while the ship's health is low; the objectives that follow are the same as a normal boarding.

steps.text: Let an enemy ship ram the Morrigan at low health, then complete the boarding objectives that follow.
If it does not happen naturally, raise the wanted level; hunter ships are assassins and ram often.

achievements.summary: Counter 15 air surprise attacks from stalkers.

guide.context: Counters only count when the kill animation plays, and fast travel resets the fixed spawn points.

steps.text: Let the roof stalkers at the @loc{Stuyvesant's Farm} viewpoint (582, -421) in @loc{New York} leap at you, then counter (E on PC) and press attack (left mouse button) for the kill.
Fast travel away and back to respawn them, and repeat until 15 air counters register.

achievements.description: Complete all Native hills and Ice Caves
achievements.estTime: all Native hills and Ice Caves
achievements.summary: Finish every Native hill and Ice Cave.

guide.context: Fort or Gang HQ control reveals an area's hills and caves. Unlock the grenade launcher and the shrapnel grenade at the end of Sequence 3 before entering ice caves.

steps.text: Capture the fort or Gang HQ for each area to reveal its @loc{Native hills} and @loc{Ice Caves} on the map.
Solve the Native Pillar at each hill and cave; use the @item{shrapnel grenade} to break the icicle walls that block some cave paths.

achievements.description: Complete an Outpost without getting detected
achievements.summary: Complete an outpost without being detected.

guide.context: Outposts reset after a failed attempt, and a late-game outpost with a single key holder is the easiest target.

steps.text: Pick an outpost with one key holder and one stash.
Infiltrate without entering conflict, take the key from its holder, open the stash with it, and leave.
steps.note: If a fight starts, reload the checkpoint and try again.

achievements.description: Hit 5 enemies with the berserk grenade (at the same time)
achievements.summary: Hit 5 enemies at the same time with a berserk grenade.

guide.context: The grenade launcher unlocks at the end of Sequence 3.

steps.text: Find a five-enemy patrol in @loc{River Valley} or near the @loc{East Village} viewpoint (659, -243) in @loc{New York}.
Fire a @item{berserk grenade} into the group while all five are close together.
steps.note: The end of a patrol, when the group stops, is the easiest moment.

achievements.description: Put 5 enemies to sleep with the sleep grenade (at the same time)
achievements.summary: Put 5 enemies to sleep at the same time with a sleep grenade.

steps.text: Use the same five-enemy patrol spots as for Instant Vikings: @loc{River Valley} patrols or the @loc{East Village} viewpoint (659, -243) in @loc{New York}.
Hit the group with a @item{sleep grenade}, then follow up with a @item{berserk grenade} on the same enemies if Instant Vikings is still missing.

guide.context: The twelfth interception appears in @loc{Greenwich} in @loc{New York} after the other 11 are complete.

steps.text: Capture the pigeon contract at each map icon, then find the marked target.
Keep the target alive by taking out the assassins hunting it; use @mechanic{Eagle Vision} to mark them yellow, then finish them with assassinations or ranged shots.
steps.note: Clear nearby red and orange enemies before accepting a contract in a crowded area.

achievements.description: Sink 10 ships in North Atlantic without dying while only the HUNTED cheat is active.
achievements.summary: Sink 10 ships in the North Atlantic in one life with only the HUNTED cheat active.

guide.context: Upgrade the mortars, hull, and round shot first, and leave every other cheat off; cheats block normal achievements.

steps.text: Turn on only the @mechanic{HUNTED cheat} from Settings > @mechanic{Abstergo Challenges} > Cheats.
Head to @loc{Fort Louis} in the southeastern @loc{North Atlantic} and sail at the cluster of red ships south of it.
Sink ten ships with mortar fire from range; hunters appear as the count climbs, so avoid them and keep sinking ships.

achievements.description: Sink 10 ships in North Atlantic without dying while only the ENDURANCE cheat is active.
achievements.summary: Sink 10 ships in the North Atlantic in one life with only the ENDURANCE cheat active.

guide.context: Upgrade the mortars, hull, and round shot first, and leave every other cheat off; cheats block normal achievements.

steps.text: Turn on only the @mechanic{ENDURANCE cheat} from Settings > @mechanic{Abstergo Challenges} > Cheats.
Head to @loc{Fort Louis} in the southeastern @loc{North Atlantic} and sail at the cluster of red ships south of it.
Sink ten ships with mortar fire from range; hunters appear as the count climbs, so avoid them and keep sinking ships.

achievements.description: Take over 10 large supply camps while only the VETERANS cheat is active.
achievements.summary: Take over 10 large supply camps with only the VETERANS cheat active.

guide.context: The VETERANS cheat raises enemy damage; dying does not reset the count and the game still saves, but loot gathered under the cheat is lost.

steps.text: Turn on only the @mechanic{VETERANS cheat} from Settings > @mechanic{Abstergo Challenges} > Cheats.
Fast travel around @loc{River Valley} and take the 3-5 supply camps shown as white carts; rush the chest or use smoke bombs and berserk darts on the defenders.
Repeat until ten large camps are taken.

achievements.description: Kill 30 guards without dying while only the ENDURANCE cheat is active.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 guards in one life with only the ENDURANCE cheat active.

guide.context: Every guard can be killed without entering conflict, and dying resets the run.

steps.text: Turn on only the @mechanic{ENDURANCE cheat} from Settings > @mechanic{Abstergo Challenges} > Cheats.
Go to @loc{Halifax} in the @loc{North Atlantic} and assassinate its 11 guards, using double assassinations on pairs.
Fast travel back to the Halifax viewpoint to respawn the guards, and repeat until 30 kills register.
